title: smallanthus oaxacanus
intro: Smallanthus oaxacanus, commonly known as Mexican dandelion or Yaquixquiac root, is a plant species native to Mexico. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Smallanthus oaxacanus include its use as a diuretic and its potential to improve liver function, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
